about: Dorst's step 6, Frames, built from the five needs in content/themes/themes.json. Every frame is an analogy: a place or system people already know. Each is a row, grouped by the candidate paradox it moves. A station marks a need the frame builds on, with one line on how; 'holds' names the two needs it lets a person have at once. Full reasoning and sources: research/frames.md.

groups.name: Seeing the Route, Making Your Own
groups.pulls: Coherence and Becoming, the README’s hunch

frames.name: The Camino
frames.done: The pilgrimage to Santiago de Compostela
frames.gives: The route stops being one path; the marks and the stamps hold still

t.W: the way is marked and holds still
t.N: your pace, your reasons; a passport records how far you’ve come
t.B: hosts who walked it themselves stamp the passport

frames.name: The Ski Resort
frames.done: Trail ratings, ski school and patrol
frames.gives: One path gives way to rated runs you choose between

t.W: signs at every junction, rated against this mountain
t.N: you choose by skill and mood, and move up
t.B: a ski school and a patrol for when you need them

frames.name: The CrossFit Box
frames.done: One workout on the whiteboard, scaled for each person
frames.gives: Everyone does the same session; how hard is yours to set

t.W: one workout, on the whiteboard, for everyone
t.N: scaled to where you are, so you can do it today
t.L: the same people at the same hour

groups.name: Seen as Yourself, Part of a Team

frames.name: The Film Credits
frames.gives: The ranking: every role on one list, no order of names

t.R: named for what you did, in words an employer can read
t.L: the list belongs to the film, not to any one name

frames.name: The Relay
frames.gives: Your leg is timed and seen, and the result is the team’s

t.R: your leg is yours, timed and seen
t.L: one result, shared by the team
t.B: a teammate hands off to you, and waits at the wall

groups.name: A Person at Every Crossing
groups.pulls: Support for the newcomer and for the organizer

frames.name: The Train Station
frames.done: Departure boards and a staffed desk; patient navigators
frames.gives: A person per station, not per traveler

t.W: the board shows every way on from here
t.B: a staffed desk at every station to ask

frames.name: The Doula
frames.gives: Continuous support, given by someone who just crossed

t.B: someone beside you the whole way across
t.N: feeling in control, and more sure you can
t.W: what’s happening, explained in plain words

frames.name: The Tailor’s Shop
frames.done: Apprenticeship, as Lave and Wenger found it
frames.gives: Helping stops being extra hours; it’s the helper’s next step

t.N: from small real tasks toward the centre
t.L: inside the shop’s real work from the first day

frames.name: The Harbor
frames.done: A ship’s home port; Recurse Center; Civic Tech DC
frames.gives: The Cycle’s claim to be the whole of The Labs

t.L: a crew keeps its berth between voyages
t.B: people who expect you, and are there when needed
t.N: a safe harbor is what lets people sail out again

frames.name: parkrun
frames.done: The free 5 km, every Saturday morning
frames.gives: The Cycle as the only way in

t.L: the same people, every week, with no season to sign up for
t.W: same time, same place, always on
t.R: every helper counted, and nobody finishes last
